limitations.detail: Corpus mixes KCEX (kcex.com) announcements with KKCex (api.kkcex.com) REST v1 docs; adapter built from KKCex API docs only
accesskey/nonce/signature are query parameters, not headers; signature=HmacSHA256(secret, ASCII-sorted params joined by '&'); nonce=13-digit ms epoch; headers field used as pseudo-mapping
batchOrder/batchCancel/getBatchOrders sign the Base64-decoded data string, not the JSON itself; Content-Type=application/x-www-form-urlencoded required
Candle timestamps are Unix seconds; trade timestamps are ms; kline uses incremental 'since' pagination (0 first, then response's since value)
markets result is a JSON object keyed by market name, not a list; no base/quote fields
entrustType 1=market defined but error 109 says market orders unsupported; stop-loss/take-profit unsupported (error 110)
No margin/futures trading API documented â margin=null
min_order_usdt not documented in USDT (per-market minAmount in base coin only) â using conservative default 10.0
Price protection band exists (error 111) but value not documented â using conservative default 5.0
qty precision varies per market (coinPoint 4-6 in examples) â using conservative default 8
fee 0.1%/side from getMarketConfig examples; site advertises 0-fee promos â actual fee may differ
collateral/leverage/interest not documented â defaults kept
Rate limits: assets 3/s, other methods 10/s per user, 1000/min per IP; 10-min lock on breach
No 4h kline interval; supported: 1min,5min,15min,30min,1hour,6hour,1day,7day,30day

Signature is a request param, not a header: signature=hex(HmacSHA256(secret, ASCII-sorted 'k=v' request params joined by '&')); params accesskey + nonce(13-digit ms timestamp) + signature sent in query (GET) or form body (POST); no expires/passphrase
Candle timestamps are SECONDS; response {datas:[[ts,o,h,l,c,v,quoteVol],...],since:N}; incremental pagination only via 'since' cursor (first call 0, then echo response 'since'); no limit/to params
No 4h interval documented; supported: 1min,5min,15min,30min,1hour,6hour,1day,7day,30day â 240m left unmapped
getTickers/getMarketConfig return top-level maps keyed by 'base_quote' (e.g. btc_usdt); base/quote must be parsed from the key
Market orders may be rejected (error 109 'market orders not supported'); stop-loss/take-profit unsupported (error 110); batchOrder/batchCancel data must be Base64-encoded JSON array, max 100 items
No margin or futures trading API documented â spot only
min_order_usdt not documented (getMarketConfig gives per-market minAmount in base-coin qty) â using conservative default 10.0
min_collateral_usdt not documented â using conservative default 10.0
max_collateral_usdt not documented â using conservative default 100000.0
max_risk_coef not documented â using conservative default 3.0
System protection price exists (order error 111) but band percentage not documented â using default 5.0
Precision is per-market via getMarketConfig: coinPoint qty decimals (examples 4-6), pricePoint price decimals (2) â qty_step default 8 used
fee_pct 0.1 taken from documented example (maker=taker=0.001); actual fees are per-market via getMarketConfig
interest_per_4h_pct not documented â using conservative default 0.05
Rate limits: balance endpoints 3 req/s, other methods 10 req/s per user, 1000 req/min per IP; exceeding locks account 10 min â min_gap_sec 0.1 derived from 10 req/s
kcex.com pages contain no API reference; REST docs sourced from github.com/kkcex/api-docs (api.kkcex.com) â may not reflect the current kcex.com API
